name: A rumor at Light’s Hope

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

summary: Quest 5462 directs the seeker to bring the keepsake to Leonid at Light’s Hope and presents Stratholme as the rumored location of Ras’s fall to the Lich King.
description: The keepsake is brought to Leonid Barthalomew at Light’s Hope Chapel. Marduke’s next quest calls Stratholme the rumored place of Ras’s surrender, then directs the seeker to the old undead who may know more. A rumor has opened a path, but it has not yet become an established account. At this small timber refuge, the witness is asked to look upon the object and remember.
